What exactly does Prospect AI do?

Prospect AI is a product that runs your outbound motion inside one platform. It finds the right accounts, builds contact lists, researches each prospect, writes personalised sequences, manages your email infrastructure, and books meetings onto your calendar. You stay in control. The software does the heavy lifting, and you approve and steer.

Those give you a database and a sender, then leave the work to you. Prospect AI does the work for you. Isabelle builds campaigns, researches accounts, and handles replies, while Recursion measures every send and sharpens the targeting and copy over time. It's still a product you run, but you're not running it alone or from scratch.
Is Prospect AI a managed service or software?

No, that's what the product is for. Isabelle drafts the sequences and builds the lists from your ICP, backed by deep account research. You review and tweak before anything sends, so the voice stays yours, but you're starting from a finished draft rather than a blank page.

Most customers spend a couple of hours a week reviewing what Isabelle has drafted, approving sends, and stepping in when a lead is ready to talk. The research, sending, follow-ups, and reply triage all happen inside the platform, so you're steering rather than doing the grunt work.
